### Bio:

I’m interested in understanding how genetic and environmental factors contribute to psychiatric and cognitive disorders, through adolescence and into late adulthood. I am also interested in chronic disease burden, sleep disorders effects on cognition, and women's health. Methods and stats-wise I'm also interested in longitudinal and SIR/ economic modelling, causal inference methods, and clinical trials.
